verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs describe off-cycle payrolls used for 'corrections' (gusto-docs-4, gusto-docs-21, gusto-docs-32) and show how to retrieve 'unprocessed' payrolls (gusto-docs-46) and version-based conflict protection (gusto-docs-25), suggesting some ability to correct or intervene before pay-out, but there is no explicit documentation of a 'cancel payroll' or 'void submitted payroll' endpoint or workflow. Missing for 10: explicit cancel/void-payroll API or UI flow, confirmation that corrections can fully replace a submitted run before employees are paid, and any hands-on/community confirmation that this works as described.
